name: combined-var-load-missing
description: XOGA-713 Combined VAR, target = datasource alias target. UAT already holds the CFS, USG and GRN accounting rows (2447); it lacks the RMC accounting rows (5) and all multiplier rows (helper_var_mult_factor_view is empty on UAT). Loads those the multiplier rows from the legacy view on mysql-oprdb02 and the RMC rows from the dev database. Insert only; each scope must be empty before (expect targetBefore 0), so a second run is refused. Preview first, then add the apply flag; the verify rule runs after the apply.

steps.note: The legacy RMC table is empty now (preview of 6 Nov read 0 rows), so the 5 RMC accounting rows are copied from the dev database, where they were loaded from legacy and verified earlier.

source.sql: SELECT uuid, tenant_id, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp, business_unit, value_date, settlement_date, subportfolio, p1_name, contract_month, vol_id, p1_settleprice, invenio_product_code, future_expiry, option_expiry, future_continuation_series, option_continuation_series, derivative_type, strike, delta, gamma, vega, theta, delta1, gamma1, vega1 FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report WHERE business_unit = 'RMC' ORDER BY uuid

steps.note: Legacy helper_var_mult_factor_view for the two value dates (124 rows per day). Without it every delta and gamma is multiplied by zero.

source.sql: SELECT invenio_product_code, value_date, curr_mult, lot_mult, mult_factor FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date IN (:vd1, :vd2) ORDER BY value_date, invenio_product_code
